segments.sn48.71-82:1.1: 541-552. “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, gaṅgā nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā;
segments.sn48.71-82:1.2: evameva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pañcindriyāni bhāvento pañcindriyāni bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro.
segments.sn48.71-82:1.3: Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pañcindriyāni bhāvento pañcindriyāni bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro?
segments.sn48.71-82:1.4: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhindriyaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ, vīriyindriyaṃ … pe … satindriyaṃ … samādhindriyaṃ … paññindriyaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
segments.sn48.71-82:1.9: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pañcindriyāni bhāvento pañcindriyāni bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro”ti.
segments.sn48.71-82:2.1: Cha pācīnato ninnā, cha ninnā ca samuddato;
segments.sn48.71-82:2.3: Dvete cha dvādasa honti, vaggo tena pavuccatīti. Appamādavaggo vitthāretabbo. Tassuddānaṃ – Tathāgataṃ padaṃ kūṭaṃ, mūlaṃ sārena vassikaṃ; Rājā candimasūriyā, vatthena dasamaṃ padanti. Balakaraṇīyavaggo vitthāretabbo. Tassuddānaṃ – Balaṃ bījañca nāgo ca, rukkho kumbhena sūkiyā; Ākāsena ca dve meghā, nāvā āgantukā nadīti. Esanāvaggo vitthāretabbo. Tassuddānaṃ – Esanā vidhā āsavo, bhavo ca dukkhatā tisso; Khilaṃ malañca nīgho ca, vedanā taṇhā tasinā cāti.
